about: The Bellwood location of the Shark's Fish & Chicken chain, offering catfish, tilapia, perch, smelt and shrimp dinners, chicken wings and tenders, and family-size mixed-fish meals for pickup and delivery.
tagline: Fried catfish, shrimp and wings to go on St. Charles Road
hours: Uber Eats store page shows 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (delivery hours). Restaurantji listing: Mon–Thu 10am–11pm; Fri–Sat 10am–1am; Sun 11am–11pm. Not confirmed from an official source.
notes: No website for this location; the Shark's sites found (getsauce) are other franchise locations (119th St Blue Island, 75th St Chicago). Phone 708-493-9300 appears on the location's own promo graphics showing 2500 St Charles Rd. A web summary said 'since 2004' but the source was unclear, so it is left out. Uber Eats page showed 'Delivery unavailable' when checked.
